en.title: Toolkit
en.desc: Free resources and interactive wellness tools for your resilience practice.
en.moodDesc: Track how you feel · Build awareness
en.moodPrompt: How are you feeling right now?
en.emotionDesc: Name what you feel · Build EQ
en.contactProvider: Contact your local {category} provider for more information. Resources are available across all 10 ASEAN countries.
en.g1Prompt: Look around and name 5 things you can see right now.
en.g2Prompt: Reach out and feel 4 different textures around you.
en.g5Prompt: Focus on 1 taste, your mouth, a sip of water.
en.aff0: I am capable of handling whatever comes my way.
en.aff1: My strength grows with every challenge I face.
en.aff2: I am a source of calm and support for others.
en.aff3: Every day I become more resilient.
en.aff5: I am making a meaningful difference in my community.
en.aff7: I am prepared to help when disaster strikes.
en.aff8: Together, we are stronger than any storm.
en.aff9: I trust my training and my instincts.
en.aff10: I am worthy of rest and recovery.
en.aff11: My training builds bridges across ASEAN.
en.emo1Tip: Try a breathing exercise or physical movement to release tension.
en.emo2Tip: It's okay to feel sad. Journaling or talking to someone can help.
en.emo3Tip: Fear is natural. Ground yourself with the 5-4-3-2-1 technique.
en.emo4Tip: Wonderful! Savor this feeling and share it with someone you care about.
en.emo5Tip: Take a moment to process the unexpected. Breathe and assess.
en.emo6Tip: Step away from what bothers you. Self-care is not selfish.
en.emo7Tip: Stay present in this peace. You've earned it.
en.emo8Tip: Break the problem into smaller steps. Progress over perfection.
en.emo9Tip: Connection is healing. Reach out to someone you appreciate.

id.title: Perkakas
id.desc: Sumber daya gratis dan alat interaktif untuk praktik ketangguhan Anda.

id.aff0: Saya mampu menghadapi apa pun yang terjadi.
id.aff1: Kekuatan saya tumbuh dengan setiap tantangan.
id.aff2: Saya adalah sumber ketenangan bagi orang lain.
id.aff3: Setiap hari saya menjadi lebih tangguh.
id.aff4: Saya memilih keberanian di atas kenyamanan.
id.aff5: Saya membawa perubahan positif di komunitas.
id.aff7: Saya siap membantu saat bencana melanda.
id.aff8: Bersama, kita lebih kuat dari badai mana pun.
id.aff9: Saya percaya pada pelatihan dan insting saya.
id.aff10: Saya layak mendapatkan istirahat dan pemulihan.
id.aff11: Pelatihan saya membangun ikatan di seluruh ASEAN.
id.emo1Tip: Coba latihan pernapasan untuk melepaskan ketegangan.
id.emo2Tip: Tidak apa bersedih. Menulis jurnal atau bicara bisa membantu.
id.emo3Tip: Rasa takut itu wajar. Tenangkan diri dengan metode 5-4-3-2-1.
id.emo4Tip: Luar biasa! Nikmati perasaan ini dan bagikan dengan orang lain.
id.emo5Tip: Luangkan waktu sejenak. Tarik napas dan evaluasi situasi.
id.emo6Tip: Jauhi hal yang mengganggu Anda. Rawat diri sendiri.
id.emo7Tip: Tetaplah di momen damai ini. Anda pantas mendapatkannya.
id.emo8Tip: Pecah masalah jadi langkah kecil. Kemajuan lebih penting dari kesempurnaan.
id.emo9Tip: Koneksi menyembuhkan. Hubungi orang yang Anda hargai.

id.sleep4: Bangun tidur di jam yang sama tiap hari
